jobs.title: Electrical Engineer - Microelectronics
jobs.description:
Join the industry leader to design the next generation of breakthroughs.

Innovate to solve the world's most important challenges.

Honeywell is a Fortune 100 company that invents and manufactures technologies to address critical challenges linked to global macrotrends such as safety, security, productivity, global urbanization and energy. With approximately 100,000 employees worldwide, including more than 19,000 engineers and scientists, Honeywell has an unrelenting focus on quality, delivery, value, and technology in everything they make and do.  Honeywell has been named a Top 100 Global Innovator for seven years in a row, recognizing the company’s global reach of portfolio and invention influence.

In Kansas City, Honeywell Federal Manufacturing & Technologies (FM&T) manages and operates the U.S. Department of Energy/National Nuclear Security Administration’s (NNSA) Kansas City National Security Campus. This state-of-the-art engineering, manufacturing and sourcing facility produces a wide array of intricate components to deliver trusted national security products and government services primarily for the NNSA. Honeywell FM&T’s culture of integrity, commitment and continuous improvement enables them to deliver responsive, collaborative and innovative management and technology services and products that translate into cutting edge solutions to complex national security issues.

Summary

The Electrical Engineer II role is an experienced level position performing routine to moderately complex engineering functions on assigned projects or sub-projects of a general nature by applying, standard mathematical, physical science, and/or engineering technologies.

Duties and Responsibilities

Assist in the design and/or project/process management of new and current projects, products, programs, components, tools, and acceptance equipment under technical guidance of higher-level technical experts.
Prepares product or project definitions, manufacturing drawings and specifications, operating procedures, and test equipment designs.
Designs product and acceptance equipment; develops measurement methods, acquires, and designates tooling, cables, laboratory and other equipment to support product acceptance.
Develops test procedures and performs routine to moderately complex engineering evaluation tests, product and process capability studies, quality audits, product or project data reviews, and other engineering evaluation work to assure product manufacturability.
Conducts audits, analyzes processes, products, and inspection records to anticipate, identify, and correct problems and to establish quality levels and trends.
Partners with internal and external stakeholders to assist in resolving moderately complex, development, production, and acceptance issues.
Prepares evaluation reports, analyzes discrepancies, makes recommendations for and initiates improvements for product.

You Must Have

Ability to travel up to 15% of the time
Bachelor of Science degree from an ABET accredited university in Engineering or Physics
2+ years of relevant experience in engineering, analytical, or related technical activities.
Ability to work remote, hybrid, or on-site as directed by management and is determined by the needs of the business
United States Citizenship
Regular and reliable attendance is an essential function of this job
Ability to obtain and maintain, if required for position, a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) security clearance (some positions require additional DOE designations)

We Value

Technical expertise in post‑die processing (die‑attach, wire/ribbon bonding, epoxy dispensing, solder reflow & gap welding, wafer/die cleaning)
Process development & optimization (Six‑Sigma/DFSS, DMAIC, SPC; metrology interpretation)
Clean‑room knowledge (Class 100–10 000 protocols)
Software & data analysis (Minitab, Python/R)
Problem‑solving (defect diagnosis & corrective actions)
Communication (technical documentation & cross‑functional presentations)
High‑volume/high‑mix manufacturing experience
Specialized process expertise (ceramic packaging, emerging interconnects)
Process‑improvement certifications (Six‑Sigma, Lean, etc.)
Tool proficiency (die‑bonders, wire/ribbon bonders, dispensers, reflow ovens, gap‑welding systems)

A robotics system behaving properly in development is one thing.

Getting it working reliably on a live manufacturing line is another.

I’m working with an early-stage physical AI company in New York City already deploying robotic systems with a major defence prime. They are now hiring a Staff Hardware Engineer to take ownership of the hardware side of those deployments.

You’ll work across the gap between engineering and the real production environment.

That means:

Deploying robotic hardware onto live manufacturing and defence production lines
Owning hardware integration, commissioning and troubleshooting on site
Working closely with machine learning engineers to get models performing reliably on physical systems
Taking problems found in the field back into hardware design and reliability decisions
Helping establish hardware engineering standards as the team grows

This is a hands-on Staff-level role. You’ll be close to the hardware, the deployment environment and the problems that only appear once a system leaves development.

They are looking for someone with senior robotics hardware experience and evidence of deploying physical systems into production or field environments.

You should also be comfortable working across hardware and software, with practical experience around sensors, actuators and robotic platforms.

$225K–$275K
Equity:
Competitive equity
Location:
New York, NY
Working pattern:
Full-time, 5 days on-site

Due to the nature of the work, US citizenship is required. The company cannot sponsor visas or employ green card holders for this position.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Collections Experience
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

About The Role

Collections Experience owns the product experience for Notion’s database block and everything on top of it: properties, views, forms, permissions, and many more features. If you’ve ever typed /database in a Notion page, you’ve already used something our team built.

We’re hiring an experienced software engineer to accelerate our mission to build a flexible, reliable, and intuitive primitive that gives everyone the power to model their work exactly as they imagine— from simple lists to the most complex workflows.

We’re 8+ engineers, designers, and PMs across SF and NYC. You’ll work across the stack in TypeScript, ship features that touch both the data model and the UI, and help shape where the database block goes next.

What You'll Achieve

Design and ship new database properties and views that expand what people can model in Notion
Design permission models that hold up at the scale of our largest customers
Partner with the Agent team to grow what Notion Agent can do with databases, from tool development to eval-driven iteration
Collaborate closely with product and design on features that are ambiguous up front and require strong technical judgment to scope
Raise the bar on code review, testing, and technical design across the team

Skills You'll Need to Bring

10+ years shipping production software, with a strong track record of owning features end-to-end
Fluency with TypeScript across both backend and frontend
Strong product instincts: you can take a vague problem, propose a solid technical approach, and know when to cut scope
Experience on systems where data model decisions have long-lived consequences (databases, permissions, collaborative editing, or similar)
You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

Nice To Haves

Experience building database, spreadsheet, or workflow tools
Background in permissions or authorization systems at scale
Familiarity with AI/agent tooling, evals, or LLM-driven product experiences

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Provider Engagement
jobs.description:
Our Mission

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.

We’re here to give power to the patient.

For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting . We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

About The Role

We're transforming how healthcare practices interact with Zocdoc, building intelligent systems that understand each practice's needs and guide them toward actions that grow their business. This means personalized homepages, smart recommendations, AI-assisted configuration, and workflows that make Zocdoc essential to daily operations.

As Senior Software Engineer, you'll build these systems end-to-end. You'll own features from design through production, work across the stack, and collaborate with Product, Design, and Data Science to ship experiences that matter.

What You'll Do

Build platform components - including practice profile services, engagement scoring pipelines, recommendation APIs, personalization infrastructure.
Ship product features end-to-end - database to API to front-end, owning the full lifecycle.
Work with Data Science to integrate ML models build feature pipelines, call model endpoints, instrument feedback loops.
Write production-ready code with strong testing, observability, and error handling.
Participate in design discussions and contribute to architecture decisions. Deliver complex components with strong engineering judgment.
Improve engineering practices - including testing, CI/CD, monitoring, documentation.
Mentor junior engineers through code reviews and pairing.

You'll enjoy this role if you are…

Inspired by the opportunity to positively impact the healthcare experience for millions of patients and providers
Passionate about building full-stack features that users love, with a strong sense of ownership from idea to production
Product-driven with a relentless focus on user needs, and excited to collaborate closely with cross-functional teams
Comfortable working with data — building pipelines, computing aggregations, and integrating ML model outputs into product experiences
A champion of engineering fundamentals who cares about code quality, testing, and maintainability
Someone who takes initiative, sees features through to completion, and takes pride in shipping
A collaborator who mentors teammates, gives thoughtful code reviews, and learns from others
A believer that diverse and inclusive teams and cultures are non-negotiable

Your day to day is…

Building platform components that power engagement intelligence — practice profile services, engagement scoring pipelines, recommendation APIs, personalization infrastructure, and more
Shipping product features end-to-end — from database schema to API to front-end, owning the full lifecycle
Working with Data Science to integrate data-driven features — building pipelines, calling model endpoints, and instrumenting feedback loops to measure outcomes
Building the product surfaces that deliver recommendations to users — personalized homepage modules, in-product messaging, and value reinforcement ("You gained 15 bookings this week")
Writing production-ready code with strong testing, observability, and error handling
Collaborating with our agile team of dedicated engineers, product managers, designers, and data scientists
Participating in design discussions — contributing to architecture decisions and learning from Staff engineers
Improving engineering practices — testing, CI/CD, monitoring, documentation
Mentoring junior engineers through code reviews and pairing

You'll be successful in this role if you have…

5+ years of software engineering experience building production systems
Full-stack capabilities — comfortable across backend services, APIs, and front-end
Experience with data pipelines or ETL — you've built systems that aggregate, transform, or serve data
Comfort working with ML outputs — you can integrate models (call APIs, handle predictions, log outcomes)
Strong fundamentals — data structures, system design, debugging
Good judgment on tradeoffs — you know when to optimize and when to ship
Ownership mentality — you see features through to production

Zocdoc is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Salary ranges are determined through alignment with market data. Base salary offered is determined by a number of factors including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and skills. Certain positions are also eligible for variable pay and/or equity; your recruiter will discuss the full compensation package details.

NYC Base Salary Range

$173,000—$221,000 USD

About Us

Zocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Each month, millions of patients use our free service to find nearby, in-network providers, compare choices based on verified patient reviews, and instantly book in-person or video visits online. Providers participate in Zocdoc’s Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. Founded in 2007 with a mission to give power to the patient, our work each day in pursuit of that mission is guided by our six core values. Zocdoc is a private company backed by some of the world’s leading investors, and we believe we’re still only scratching the surface of what we plan to accomplish.

Zocdoc is a mission-driven organization dedicated to building teams as diverse as the patients and providers we aim to serve. In the spirit of one of our core values - Together, Not Alone , we are a company that prides itself on being highly collaborative, and we believe that diverse perspectives, experiences and contributors make our community and our platform better. We’re an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Applicants are considered for employment regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or any other class protected by applicable laws.

jobs.title: Power Systems Engineer – Strategic Projects
jobs.description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.

Your impact

We are seeking a highly motivated Power Systems Engineer – Strategic Projects
to support strategic utility initiatives, capital projects, system modernization, and emerging technologies across our high-voltage transmission and substation infrastructure. This role is ideal for an engineer who thrives in a dynamic environment and enjoys solving complex technical challenges that extend beyond traditional engineering assignments.

The successful candidate will lead and support a diverse portfolio of projects involving substations, transmission systems, renewables integration, grid modernization, system planning, equipment replacement programs, and operational improvements. Assignments will vary based on business needs and may require collaboration across engineering, operations, construction, regulatory, and executive leadership teams.

This position offers exceptional exposure to utility modernization and provides opportunities to influence critical infrastructure investments and strategic initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Engineering & Project Leadership

Lead special projects involving high-voltage substations, transmission systems, protection and control systems, and grid infrastructure.
Perform engineering studies, technical evaluations, and system assessments.
Develop project scopes, technical specifications, design criteria, and engineering recommendations.
Support conceptual, preliminary, and detailed engineering design activities.
Coordinate engineering efforts through project lifecycle phases including planning, design, construction, commissioning, and closeout.
Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend implementation strategies.

System Modernization & Strategic Initiatives

Support utility modernization efforts including
Substation automation
Digital substations
SCADA and communications systems
Grid resiliency initiatives
Asset management programs
Renewable energy integration
Energy storage projects

Investigate operational challenges and develop innovative technical solutions.
Conduct benchmarking, research, and technical due diligence for strategic investments.

Technical Analysis

Guide system studies to meet project objectives including
Load flow analysis
Short-circuit studies
Arc flash analysis
Equipment loading assessments
Reliability evaluations
Power quality investigations

Analyze equipment performance and failure trends.
Develop recommendations to improve system reliability, safety, and operational efficiency.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with Energy and Power teams including System Studies, Protection & Controls, Substation and Transmission Design, Generation, and other Jacobs business units.
Interface with consultants, vendors, contractors, and external stakeholders.
Present technical findings and recommendations to leadership.
Support capital budgeting, forecasting, and project prioritization efforts. #epjobs #naepjobs

Desired Attributes

The ideal candidate will be

Curious and innovative.
Comfortable working in ambiguity.
Able to quickly learn new technologies and business areas.
Equally effective in the office, field, and executive settings.
Self-directed and capable of leading initiatives with limited supervision.
Passionate about modernizing and strengthening the electric grid.
Enjoys guiding and developing less-experienced engineers through project delivery, engineering standards, and industry best practices.

Why This Role Is Unique

Unlike a traditional substation engineering position, this role provides the opportunity to work across disciplines and tackle the utility's most critical and visible challenges. One month may involve evaluating a new 230kV substation, while the next may focus on battery energy storage integration, wildfire mitigation, transmission upgrades, or strategic infrastructure planning. This position is designed for engineers who enjoy variety, ownership, and making a measurable impact on the future of the power system.

Here's what you'll need

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering from an ABET-accredited institution.
12+ years of utility, transmission, substation, or power systems engineering experience.
Experience with high-voltage systems ranging from 69kV through 500kV.
Knowledge of substation equipment including
Power transformers
Circuit breakers
Disconnect switches
Instrument transformers
Protection and control systems
Bus configurations

Familiarity with applicable industry standards including IEEE, NESC, NEC, and utility design practices.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple projects and changing priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

Professional Engineer (PE) license or ability to obtain.
Utility transmission owner/operator experience.
Experience supporting renewable generation interconnections (PV, wind, BESS).
Familiarity with relay protection and control systems.
Experience with EPC or consultant-managed projects.
Knowledge of
PSCAD
ETAP
SKM
ASPEN
CAPE
CYME
PSS®E
PowerWorld

Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.

Experience With FERC, NERC, WECC, Or Regional Reliability Requirements.

Our health and welfare benefits are designed to invest in you, and in the things you care about. Your health. Your well-being. Your security. Your future. Employees have access to medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance, a 401(k) plan, and the ability to purchase company stock at a discount. Eligible employees may also enroll in a deferred compensation plan or the Executive Deferral Plan. Jacobs has an unlimited U.S. Personalized Paid Time Off (PPTO) policy for full-time salaried/exempt employees, seven paid holidays, and caregiver leave. And certain roles may be eligible for additional rewards, including merit increases, performance discretionary bonus, and stock.

The base salary range for this position is $132,900.00 to $174,450.00. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. Job posted on September 24, 2026. This position will be open for at least 3 days.

At Jacobs, we’re partnering across the globe to create the best project outcomes by maximizing the design, digital technology, and support capabilities of our Global Integrated Delivery (GID) teammates. By joining Jacobs, you’ll commit to supporting and engaging with these teams, as we work to build a company like no other.

Qualified applicants with criminal histories will be considered for employment

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

Collections Experience owns the product experience for Notion’s database block and everything on top of it: properties, views, forms, permissions, and many more features. If you’ve ever typed /database in a Notion page, you’ve already used something our team built.

We’re hiring an experienced software engineer to accelerate our mission to build a flexible, reliable, and intuitive primitive that gives everyone the power to model their work exactly as they imagine— from simple lists to the most complex workflows.

We’re 8+ engineers, designers, and PMs across SF and NYC. You’ll work across the stack in TypeScript, ship features that touch both the data model and the UI, and help shape where the database block goes next.

What You'll Achieve

Design and ship new database properties and views that expand what people can model in Notion
Design permission models that hold up at the scale of our largest customers
Partner with the Agent team to grow what Notion Agent can do with databases, from tool development to eval-driven iteration
Collaborate closely with product and design on features that are ambiguous up front and require strong technical judgment to scope

new_jobs.description:
Our Mission

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.

We’re here to give power to the patient.

For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting . We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

About The Role

We're transforming how healthcare practices interact with Zocdoc, building intelligent systems that understand each practice's needs and guide them toward actions that grow their business. This means personalized homepages, smart recommendations, AI-assisted configuration, and workflows that make Zocdoc essential to daily operations.

As Senior Software Engineer, you'll build these systems end-to-end. You'll own features from design through production, work across the stack, and collaborate with Product, Design, and Data Science to ship experiences that matter.

What You'll Do

Build platform components - including practice profile services, engagement scoring pipelines, recommendation APIs, personalization infrastructure.
Ship product features end-to-end - database to API to front-end, owning the full lifecycle.
Work with Data Science to integrate ML models build feature pipelines, call model endpoints, instrument feedback loops.
Write production-ready code with strong testing, observability, and error handling.
Participate in design discussions and contribute to architecture decisions. Deliver complex components with strong engineering judgment.
Improve engineering practices - including testing, CI/CD, monitoring, documentation.
Mentor junior engineers through code reviews and pairing.

You'll enjoy this role if you are…

Inspired by the opportunity to positively impact the healthcare experience for millions of patients and providers
Passionate about building full-stack features that users love, with a strong sense of ownership from idea to production
Product-driven with a relentless focus on user needs, and excited to collaborate closely with cross-functional teams
Comfortable working with data — building pipelines, computing aggregations, and integrating ML model outputs into product experiences
A champion of engineering fundamentals who cares about code quality, testing, and maintainability
Someone who takes initiative, sees features through to completion, and takes pride in shipping
A collaborator who mentors teammates, gives thoughtful code reviews, and learns from others
A believer that diverse and inclusive teams and cultures are non-negotiable

Your day to day is…

Building platform components that power engagement intelligence — practice profile services, engagement scoring pipelines, recommendation APIs, personalization infrastructure, and more
Shipping product features end-to-end — from database schema to API to front-end, owning the full lifecycle
Working with Data Science to integrate data-driven features — building pipelines, calling model endpoints, and instrumenting feedback loops to measure outcomes
Building the product surfaces that deliver recommendations to users — personalized homepage modules, in-product messaging, and value reinforcement ("You gained 15 bookings this week")
Writing production-ready code with strong testing, observability, and error handling
Collaborating with our agile team of dedicated engineers, product managers, designers, and data scientists
Participating in design discussions — contributing to architecture decisions and learning from Staff engineers
Improving engineering practices — testing, CI/CD, monitoring, documentation
Mentoring junior engineers through code reviews and pairing

You'll be successful in this role if you have…

5+ years of software engineering experience building production systems
Full-stack capabilities — comfortable across backend services, APIs, and front-end
Experience with data pipelines or ETL — you've built systems that aggregate, transform, or serve data
Comfort working with ML outputs — you can integrate models (call APIs, handle predictions, log outcomes)
Strong fundamentals — data structures, system design, debugging
Good judgment on tradeoffs — you know when to optimize and when to ship
Ownership mentality — you see features through to production

Zocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. new_jobs.description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.

Your impact

We are seeking a highly motivated Power Systems Engineer – Strategic Projects
to support strategic utility initiatives, capital projects, system modernization, and emerging technologies across our high-voltage transmission and substation infrastructure. This role is ideal for an engineer who thrives in a dynamic environment and enjoys solving complex technical challenges that extend beyond traditional engineering assignments.

The successful candidate will lead and support a diverse portfolio of projects involving substations, transmission systems, renewables integration, grid modernization, system planning, equipment replacement programs, and operational improvements. Assignments will vary based on business needs and may require collaboration across engineering, operations, construction, regulatory, and executive leadership teams.

This position offers exceptional exposure to utility modernization and provides opportunities to influence critical infrastructure investments and strategic initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Engineering & Project Leadership

Lead special projects involving high-voltage substations, transmission systems, protection and control systems, and grid infrastructure.
Perform engineering studies, technical evaluations, and system assessments.
Develop project scopes, technical specifications, design criteria, and engineering recommendations.
Support conceptual, preliminary, and detailed engineering design activities.
Coordinate engineering efforts through project lifecycle phases including planning, design, construction, commissioning, and closeout.
Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend implementation strategies.

System Modernization & Strategic Initiatives

Support utility modernization efforts including
Substation automation
Digital substations
SCADA and communications systems
Grid resiliency initiatives
Asset management programs
Renewable energy integration
Energy storage projects

Investigate operational challenges and develop innovative technical solutions.
Conduct benchmarking, research, and technical due diligence for strategic investments.

Technical Analysis

Guide system studies to meet project objectives including
Load flow analysis
Short-circuit studies
Arc flash analysis
Equipment loading assessments
Reliability evaluations
Power quality investigations

Analyze equipment performance and failure trends.
Develop recommendations to improve system reliability, safety, and operational efficiency.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with Energy and Power teams including System Studies, Protection & Controls, Substation and Transmission Design, Generation, and other Jacobs business units.
Interface with consultants, vendors, contractors, and external stakeholders.
Present technical findings and recommendations to leadership.
Support capital budgeting, forecasting, and project prioritization efforts. #epjobs #naepjobs

Desired Attributes

The ideal candidate will be

Curious and innovative.
Comfortable working in ambiguity.
Able to quickly learn new technologies and business areas.
Equally effective in the office, field, and executive settings.
Self-directed and capable of leading initiatives with limited supervision.
Passionate about modernizing and strengthening the electric grid.

Why This Role Is Unique

Unlike a traditional substation engineering position, this role provides the opportunity to work across disciplines and tackle the utility's most critical and visible challenges. One month may involve evaluating a new 230kV substation, while the next may focus on battery energy storage integration, wildfire mitigation, transmission upgrades, or strategic infrastructure planning. This position is designed for engineers who enjoy variety, ownership, and making a measurable impact on the future of the power system.

Here's what you'll need

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering from an ABET-accredited institution.
12+ years of utility, transmission, substation, or power systems engineering experience.
Experience with high-voltage systems ranging from 69kV through 500kV.
Knowledge of substation equipment including
Power transformers
Circuit breakers
Disconnect switches
Instrument transformers
Protection and control systems
Bus configurations

Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple projects and changing priorities.

Professional Engineer (PE) license or ability to obtain.
Utility transmission owner/operator experience.
Experience supporting renewable generation interconnections (PV, wind, BESS).
Familiarity with relay protection and control systems.
Experience with EPC or consultant-managed projects.

PSCAD

SKM
ASPEN
CAPE
CYME
PSS®E
PowerWorld

Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.

Experience With FERC, NERC, WECC, Or Regional Reliability Requirements.
